meta.decision: D270 The palette is re-printed (2026-09-06) over D103a Fescue (2026-08-27) over D76 Charcoal bones; extracted 2026-08-26 under D98 (Phase A1)
meta.source: Extracted from index.html, which remains the live web client. This file is now the SOURCE OF TRUTH: preflight check 10 fails if the two disagree, so a colour changed in one place and not the other cannot ship.
meta.note: A token with no `light` value is theme-independent BY DESIGN and must NOT be given one without a decision-log entry. Three families are deliberately pinned in both themes: the geometry (radius, space, alpha, track), the type/motion/shadow stacks, and the `object` ramp — a physical object does not re-print when the room's lights change (D266, D270).

ground.note: Surfaces, darkest to raised. D270: bg0 is 49% further from black than D103b's (dE 10.28 at chroma 6.35), so the fescue is nameable; the light theme is warm almanac stock, not a paler dark. `line2` is deleted and `line` is renamed `rule` — the system has ONE hairline and no border token.

rule.note: the ONE hairline — 2.66:1 on bg0, and there is no border token

semantic.note: SEMANTIC ONLY — performance up/down, a falling row. Never decorative, and NEVER money: D273 puts money in `ink`, the pot in `gold`, and the sign in a word. D270 · four light inks are 1-6% darker than the design table printed them, because `bg2` is now warm almanac stock (#DED8C8) rather than the old cool #E5EAE4 and the table's values landed at 4.48 / 4.28 / 4.17 / 4.08 : 1 on it. D211 / Y-32 is repo law and a hex in a table is not: gold #7A5A12->#795912, brand #A8420F->#A13F0E, pos #0B7340->#0A6D3C, cool #5D6862->#56615B, and all four now clear 4.5:1 on bg0, bg1 AND bg2. Hue is unchanged; only value moved.

cool.note: cooling: falling rows — slate, not alarm (was heat.cool)

metal.note: Two metals and only two (D269). ember = LIVE and the one primary action; champagne gold = EARNED and nothing else. One gold object per viewport, counted by hue; at most two ember marks. Gold may never touch a control. `dawn` and `pine` are deleted. D270 · four light inks are 1-6% darker than the design table printed them, because `bg2` is now warm almanac stock (#DED8C8) rather than the old cool #E5EAE4 and the table's values landed at 4.48 / 4.28 / 4.17 / 4.08 : 1 on it. D211 / Y-32 is repo law and a hex in a table is not: gold #7A5A12->#795912, brand #A8420F->#A13F0E, pos #0B7340->#0A6D3C, cool #5D6862->#56615B, and all four now clear 4.5:1 on bg0, bg1 AND bg2. Hue is unchanged; only value moved.

gold.note: champagne / bronze on paper — EARNED only: leads, the pot, trophies

brand.note: ember / stamp red on paper — live, and the one primary action

squad.note: Four squad hues, re-cut off the metals so a team colour can never be mistaken for ember or champagne (D270).

object.note: D266 · the three containers, and the inks that ride on them. The PANEL inverts between the printings (it is a chip of the other theme's paper); the LEAF does not (it is a scorecard, and scorecards are cream in every light); the CEREMONY ramp is pinned in BOTH themes because a physical object does not re-print. The last four are the off-palette literals four surface specs had written inline, named here so preflight 15 passes.

panel.note: the panel: one opaque tile, <=96x96, one figure or one word

leaf.note: the leaf: a sheet of scorecard paper, and it must hold a grid

leaf-ink.note: scorecard ink — the same in both printings, and it has no colour

leaf-gold.note: gold ON PAPER — the light theme's gold, pinned in BOTH printings, because the leaf does not invert and dark gold at 2pt on bone is a pale smear (profile.md D-6). It is a RULE only; gold ink on a leaf is 1.68:1 and stays forbidden.

ceremony.note: the honour room — pinned in both themes

crest.note: the crest plate behind a medallion

folio-rule.note: the folio hairline on an object, which is not the page rule

scrim-ink.note: type over a photograph — the photo is the ground, not the theme

pigment.note: D271 · the six discs a face is drawn on, chosen deterministically from the golfer's id and frozen with the glyph. A pigment carries NO meaning — two golfers with the same marker become two different coins, and nothing is implied by which.

radius.note: Five radii. `p` is the panel's corner — the tile is nearly square, because a figure in a rounded box reads as a button.

rx.note: the credential and the settlement card — the two artefacts

space.note: One spacing scale, and it is the only one. `rail` is the 44pt rank rail — the signature — and `hair` is the hairline's width, so a rule is never 0.5 on one client and 1 on the other.

alpha.note: The five opacities anything in the system is allowed to be. Bare numbers, not percentages.

track.note: Letterspacing, as a RATIO of the rendered point size — never a length, so it holds at AX3. D268 resolves the group at nine values: UI_SYSTEM 1.2's table asks for eight and 1.7's ordinal for a ninth, which the four names that section proposes cannot express.

flat.note: body, prose, anything set in a sentence

ord.note: the ordinal suffix on a figure

type.note: Four voices (D268): BOARD is the brand's own — IBM Plex Sans Condensed, bundled; sans is prose; mono keeps what print gave it (columns of figures, codes, handles, times); serif is memory and honour. Charter is retired — it has no display cut, no optical sizes, one weight step, and must be addressed by PostScript string, which is D258's defect class.

board.note: the figure, the rail, every title — bundled, and a stack does not load a face

mono.dark: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

serif.dark: ui-serif, 'New York', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif

motion.note: Two easings. `roll` is the putt dying at the hole — arrivals and settles. `snap` is a control answering a finger, and it is the only thing allowed to be fast.

shadow.note: Two shadows, and neither of them is depth for its own sake: the lifted sheet, and the single dark line under a leaf that says it is a piece of paper. `shadow-rest` is deleted — it had zero references.

leaf-shade.note: the leaf sits on the page

looks.note: D103a — the looks: a bounded override set a calendar window or a league phase turns on. accent/accent2 only. Never ground, ink, pos/neg, cool, heat, squads or gold — those are semantic or earned, and a look that tinted them would make the app lie about whether you went up or down. D313: accent2 finally REACHES something (the masthead tick, the section rule's far half, and the panel — the chosen state); the emoji `motif` is RETIRED, it rendered only in the look-picker rows; Two Teams' accent2 moved #D33A4A to #C23544, the one look whose second colour carried legible ink neither way on a panel. Windows are m1,d1,m2,d2; odd_years marks the biennial team match. D103b: dark accents lifted so every eyebrow passes 4.5:1 on bg0 and bg1. D270: a look tints THE RAIL AND THE EYEBROW ONLY, never a ground; the accents that pointed at `pine`, `fire` or `dawn` now point at tokens that still exist.
